notes: t57 plan section 5, criterion B3, transcribed verbatim. These values are
fixed BEFORE the run. loadgen.py verify-slo asserts them against constants
compiled into the tool, so this file cannot be edited to make a run pass.
They were NOT softened because the container CPU quota was raised: raising
the quota buys a fair measurement, not a lower bar.
Compound criterion. A throughput number without an error rate and a latency
bound is not a result. 10 000 req/s 'achieved' with an error rate above
0.5 percent is not 10 000 req/s; the compliant rate is reported instead.
min_sustained_seconds means 60 seconds CONTINUOUS, measured as the longest
run of consecutive whole seconds at or above target. Not a peak, not a mean.
max_p99_ms applies to the coordinated-omission-corrected latency, which is
measured from the INTENDED send time. Service-time p99 is reported alongside
but does not satisfy this criterion.
A step whose bottleneck is any client_* outcome is not a server capacity
result and cannot pass, whatever rate it reached.
Passing every criterion still flips no SPEC-COVERAGE claim: this runs a
non-proof profile on loopback with raised limits, by design.
